fact: From 17 August 2026 licensed surveyors must file georeferenced parcel plans online with the Guichet unique du foncier, parcels carry a Numéro unique parcellaire, and the new land agency ANDF, created September 2025 with a director general named 6 October 2026, is to set up a national land information system.
title: Foncier : après la nomination de son DG, l'ANDF face au défi de son opérationnalisation
